title: AI-generated posters don’t have to be horrible
summary: The article explores techniques for creating high-quality AI-generated event posters using modern image generation models, moving beyond the typical low-quality outputs. It demonstrates practical prompting strategies and workflows that produce professional-looking poster designs.
problem_solved: Solves the common problem of AI-generated posters looking generic, unprofessional, or visually unappealing.
why_valuable: Provides actionable techniques and prompting strategies that help designers and marketers create polished AI-generated visual content for real-world use cases.
